/** A hosted sign-in link for the toolkit (valid for 10 minutes), and the account it will fill. */
export async function startConnection(userId: string, toolkit: Toolkit, callbackUrl: string) {
  const request = await composio().connectedAccounts.link(userId, authConfig(toolkit), {
    callbackUrl,
  })
  return { accountId: request.id, redirectUrl: request.redirectUrl as string }
}

/** One page of a connected account's items for the import picker, with what's already here. */
export async function browse(ownerId: string, id: string, query: string, page?: string) {
  const row = await ownConnection(ownerId, id)
  if (row.status !== "active") throw new LibraryError("Connect it first", 409)
  const result = await plainly(id, () =>
    row.toolkit === "gmail"
      ? gmailSearch(ownerId, row.accountId, query, page)
      : row.toolkit === "googledrive"
        ? driveSearch(ownerId, row.accountId, query, page)
        : notionSearch(ownerId, row.accountId, query, page),
  )
  const ids = result.items.map((i) => i.id)
  const have = ids.length
    ? await db
        .select({ externalId: files.externalId })
        .from(files)
        .where(
          and(eq(files.connectionId, id), inArray(files.externalId, ids), isNull(files.deletedAt)),
        )
    : []
  const imported = new Set(have.map((h) => h.externalId))
  return {
    items: result.items.map((i) => ({ ...i, imported: imported.has(i.id) })),
    next: result.next,
  }
}

/**
 * Brings a connected item's content into Konkyo's storage (plan F35), the first time and after it
 * changed at the source: an email becomes a page with its headers, a Drive file its own bytes
 * (Google's formats exported), a Notion page its Markdown. Then it's read like any upload.
 */
export async function materialize(file: FileRow): Promise<FileRow> {
  const connection = file.connectionId
    ? await db.query.connections.findFirst({ where: eq(connections.id, file.connectionId) })
    : undefined
  if (!connection || !file.externalId)
    throw new ProblemError(
      "unreachable",
      "Its connection was removed. Connect it again to read this file.",
    )
  if (connection.status === "expired")
    throw new ProblemError(
      "unreachable",
      `Reconnect ${NAMES[connection.toolkit]} in Settings to read this.`,
    )
  const { ownerId, accountId } = connection
  try {
    if (connection.toolkit === "gmail") {
      const [messageId, attachmentId] = file.externalId.split("/") as [string, string?]
      const message = await gmailMessage(ownerId, accountId, messageId)
      if (attachmentId) {
        const attachment = message.attachments.find((a) => a.id === attachmentId)
        if (!attachment) throw new ProblemError("unreachable", "This attachment is gone from Gmail")
        const remote = await gmailAttachment(ownerId, accountId, messageId, attachment)
        const kind = kindForName(remote.name)
        if (!kind) throw new ProblemError("unsupported", `${remote.name} can't be read yet`)
        return store(file, remote.name, await download(remote), remote.mimeType, kind)
      }
      const when = message.date ? new Date(message.date).toUTCString() : ""
      const head = [`From ${message.from}`, message.to ? `To ${message.to}` : "", when]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map(escapeHtml)
        .join(" · ")
      const html = documentHtml(
        message.subject,
        `<h1>${escapeHtml(message.subject)}</h1><p class="source">${head}</p>${paragraphs(message.text)}`,
      )
      const row = await store(
        file,
        `${messageId}.html`,
        new TextEncoder().encode(html),
        "text/html",
        "email",
        message.subject,
      )
      await importAttachments(file, connection, messageId, message.attachments)
      return row
    }
    if (connection.toolkit === "googledrive") {
      const remote = await driveDownload(ownerId, accountId, file.externalId, file.mime ?? "")
      const kind = kindForName(remote.name)
      if (!kind) throw new ProblemError("unsupported", `${remote.name} can't be read yet`)
      return store(file, remote.name, await download(remote), remote.mimeType, kind)
    }
    const page = await notionPage(ownerId, accountId, file.externalId)
    if (!page.markdown.trim()) throw new ProblemError("no_text", "This Notion page is empty")

 */

/**
 * Connect (or reconnect) a toolkit: a fresh hosted sign-in link (they last 10 minutes), and the
 * connection it will fill. Settings opens the link and watches the connection turn active.
 */
export async function connect(ownerId: string, toolkit: Toolkit) {
  if (!env.COMPOSIO_API_KEY) throw new LibraryError("Connectors aren't set up on this server", 503)
  const existing = await db.query.connections.findFirst({
    where: and(eq(connections.ownerId, ownerId), eq(connections.toolkit, toolkit)),
  })
  // No #fragment: the hosted page appends its own query to this address.
  const callback = `${env.BETTER_AUTH_URL}/settings?connected=${toolkit}`
  const { accountId, redirectUrl } = await startConnection(ownerId, toolkit, callback).catch(
    (error: Error) => {
      throw new LibraryError(`${NAMES[toolkit]} couldn't start: ${error.message}`, 502)
    },
  )
  if (existing) {
    // Reconnecting: the old account goes, the imports stay linked to this connection.
    if (existing.accountId !== accountId) void removeAccount(existing.accountId)
    await db
      .update(connections)
      .set({ accountId, status: "initiated" })
      .where(eq(connections.id, existing.id))
    return { id: existing.id, redirectUrl }
  }
  const [row] = await db
    .insert(connections)
    .values({ ownerId, toolkit, accountId })
    .returning({ id: connections.id })
  if (!row) throw new LibraryError("Couldn't start the connection", 500)
  return { id: row.id, redirectUrl }
}

/**
 * Import picked items (F35): each becomes a file that the worker fetches and reads like an upload;
 * one already imported isn't added twice. Unreadable kinds are skipped and counted.
 */
export async function importItems(
  ownerId: string,
  id: string,
  input: {
    items: Pick<RemoteItem, "id" | "title" | "version" | "mimeType">[]
    folderId?: string
  },
) {
  const row = await ownConnection(ownerId, id)
  const limited = await allowanceLeft(ownerId, "files", input.items.length)
  if (limited) throw new LibraryError(limited, 429)
  if (input.folderId) await fileableFolder(ownerId, input.folderId)
  const ids = input.items.map((i) => i.id)
  const have = ids.length
    ? await db
        .select({ externalId: files.externalId })
        .from(files)
        .where(
          and(eq(files.connectionId, id), inArray(files.externalId, ids), isNull(files.deletedAt)),
        )
    : []
  const already = new Set(have.map((h) => h.externalId))
  let added = 0
  let skipped = 0
  for (const item of input.items) {
    if (already.has(item.id)) continue
    const kind = kindFor(row.toolkit, item)
    if (!kind) {
      skipped++
      continue
    }
    const [file] = await db
      .insert(files)
      .values({
        ownerId,
        title: item.title,
        kind,
        mime: item.mimeType ?? null,
        status: "queued",
        stage: "Waiting to be read",
        connectionId: id,
        externalId: item.id,
        externalVersion: item.version,
      })
      .returning({ id: files.id })
    if (!file) continue
    if (input.folderId)
      await db
        .insert(fileFolders)
        .values({ fileId: file.id, folderId: input.folderId })
        .onConflictDoNothing()
    await enqueue("ingest", { fileId: file.id }, file.id)
    added++
  }
  return { added, skipped, already: already.size }
}

/** A Gmail search whose new matches come in by themselves, into a folder (or stop watching). */
export async function setWatch(
  ownerId: string,
  id: string,
  input: { watchQuery: string | null; folderId?: string | null },
) {
  const row = await ownConnection(ownerId, id)
  if (row.toolkit !== "gmail") throw new LibraryError("Only Gmail watches a search", 400)
  if (input.folderId) await fileableFolder(ownerId, input.folderId)
  await db
    .update(connections)
    .set({
      watchQuery: input.watchQuery?.trim() || null,
      ...(input.folderId !== undefined ? { folderId: input.folderId } : {}),
      // New matches count from now, not from the account's whole history.
      syncedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(eq(connections.id, id))
}

async function run<T>(
  slug: string,
  userId: string,
  accountId: string,
  args: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<T> {
  let result: { successful?: boolean; error?: string | null; data?: unknown }
  try {
    result = (await composio().tools.execute(slug, {
      userId,
      connectedAccountId: accountId,
      arguments: args,
    })) as typeof result
  } catch (error) {
    const message = (error as Error).message ?? String(error)
    throw new ConnectorError(message, EXPIRED.test(message))
  }
  if (!result.successful) {
    const message = result.error ?? `${slug} failed`
    throw new ConnectorError(message, EXPIRED.test(message))
  }
  return result.data as T
}

/** One email in full: headers, its plain text and its attachments. */
export async function gmailMessage(userId: string, accountId: string, messageId: string) {
  const m = await run<GmailMessage>("GMAIL_FETCH_MESSAGE_BY_MESSAGE_ID", userId, accountId, {
    message_id: messageId,
    format: "full",
  })
  // The attachment list is untyped in the schema (S00), so both spellings are read.
  const attachments: Attachment[] = (m.attachmentList ?? []).flatMap((a) => {
    const id = (a.attachmentId ?? a.attachment_id ?? a.id) as string | undefined
    const name = (a.filename ?? a.fileName ?? a.name) as string | undefined
    return id && name
      ? [{ id, name, mimeType: String(a.mimeType ?? a.mime_type ?? "application/octet-stream") }]
      : []
  })
  return {
    id: m.messageId ?? messageId,
    subject: m.subject?.trim() || "(no subject)",
    from: m.sender ?? "",
    to: m.to ?? "",
    date: m.messageTimestamp ?? null,
    text: m.messageText ?? "",
    attachments,
  }
}

/** A Drive file's bytes (Google's own formats exported first). */
export async function driveDownload(
  userId: string,
  accountId: string,
  fileId: string,
  mimeType: string,
): Promise<RemoteFile> {
  const exported = WORKSPACE_EXPORTS[mimeType]
  const data = await run<{
    name?: string
    downloaded_file_content?: { s3url?: string; name?: string; mimetype?: string } | null
    export_size_limit_exceeded?: boolean
  }>("GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE", userId, accountId, {
    fileId,
    ...(exported ? { mime_type: exported.mime } : {}),
  })
  if (data.export_size_limit_exceeded)
    throw new ConnectorError("Google can't export a file this big (over 10 MB)")
  const file = data.downloaded_file_content
  if (!file?.s3url) throw new ConnectorError("Couldn't download that file from Drive")
  const name = file.name ?? data.name ?? "Drive file"
  return {
    url: file.s3url,
    name: exported && !name.endsWith(exported.ext) ? `${name}${exported.ext}` : name,
    mimeType: file.mimetype ?? exported?.mime ?? mimeType,
  }
}

/** A Notion page as Markdown (one call), with when it was last edited. */
export async function notionPage(userId: string, accountId: string, pageId: string) {
  const data = await run<{ markdown?: string; truncated?: boolean }>(
    "NOTION_GET_PAGE_MARKDOWN",
    userId,
    accountId,
    { page_id: pageId },
  )
  return { markdown: data.markdown ?? "", truncated: Boolean(data.truncated) }
}
